limitations: macOS internal baseline without pinned CPU affinity; no published v0.8.16 or Polars comparison
RSS is periodically sampled, not process high-water; short 3-row workers may finish between samples, so reported values can reflect startup only
Native stack counts are inclusive and cannot be added or assigned exclusively to concat_str; allocation attribution remains a hypothesis
Timing samples validate every output outside timer; separate profiles validate preflight and final output only
Complete phase includes original snapshot operations and input list regeneration; four phases are not additive
Resource deltas surround operation and include instrumentation overhead; zero block counters do not mean whole-process IO was zero
Retained baseline, not temporally interleaved AB/BA; report every increase and do not infer noise from the diagnostic band
No allocation counts were directly measured; row-buffer reuse and elapsed-time improvement do not prove all remaining allocation cost is explained
